decisive_items: struck by lightning directly to the right forehead while hiking
Intraretinal cystoid changes and subfoveal ellipsoid zone disruption in the right eye
response.rationale: The patient was directly struck by lightning, causing electrical injury to the eye, which is a high-specificity mechanism. The presence of intraretinal cystoid changes and subfoveal ellipsoid zone disruption supports this diagnosis.

rejected.why: Cataract is a possible consequence of the injury, but it is not the primary diagnosis.
Cystoid macular edema is a feature of the injury, but it is not the primary diagnosis.
Photoreceptor damage is a feature of the injury, but it is not the primary diagnosis.
